Bird Island update: Book Withdrawn

By: Liz Fish | Production

Proposal


Show:

Unique Selling Point:
New evidence has come to light that the book” The lost boys of Bird Island” is in fact fiction and not fact. Yet 18 months later Media 24 are going ahead publishing an apology that stands by their story as fact and only apologises that Barend name was revealed. But in the last 18 month not one victim or their family has come forward. In stark contrast to Willem Breytenbach senior Media 24 employee arrested for paedophilia and 36 victims have come forward after he was exposed.

Summary:
“The Lost Boys of Bird Island” is billed as a shocking expose of a violent paedophile ring involving national party ministers and young coloured boys in the eighties. It rocked the country as the latest dark secret to be revealed from the apartheid era. It alleged an appalling abuse of power – power that extended to Minister of Defence General Magnus Malan, Finance Minister Barend du Plessis – although he wasn’t named in the book – and Environment Minister John Wiley. They supposedly commandeered a South African Air Force helicopter to fly them and their under-age victims to Bird Island.
Ever since the book was published Barend Du Plessis has been trying to clear his name and demanding that Media 24 take down all the Google posts, withdraw the books and publish an unequivocal apology admitting they had no concrete evidence and that book should never have been published as fact.
John Scott the public prosecutor who is alleged to have called Minnie in and told him to stop his investigation into the Ministers because he got instructions from “on Top” denies he ever met Minnie or that he ever got such instructions. His only involvement was after David Allen was arrested for procession of pornographic material he committed suicide and so the case was closed. That was it, Minnie entire story that the only hard evidence was stolen from him and on which Chris Steyn etc have based the reason for not having hard evidence falls apart


Further information:
Wileys sons have spent years investigating their fathers history and have never found a victim. Other key witnesses are Willie Maritz an ornithologist who spent the weekend in question on the island with them and was in their company most of the time and would have noticed any flights or children on the island. (we have done this interview) Then there is Beneke who had the guano concession for Bird Island and his affidavit says he controlled all accces to the island at the time.
Media 24’s legal team said when Willem Breytenbach a senior media 24 employee when he was arrested for paedophilia all they needed was one credible affidavit and they could release the story. Yet Minnie said weeks before the publication of “The Lost Boys on Bird Island” that they did not have any such affidavit against the Ministers yet they went ahead and published saying the press are governed under media legislation that does not apply to publications of books, and dead men cannot sue the only possible person is Barend. Barend is elderly and dying of lung cancer and they know he will be dead before he can successfully clear his name.

Script:


Script “ 18 months ago this book hit the shelves and caused an uproar
Original story Link The lost boys of Bird Island is billed as a shocking expose of a violent paedophile ring involving national party ministers and young coloured boys in the eighties. It rocked the country as the latest dark secret to be revealed from the apartheid era
Script: It alleged an appalling abuse of power – power that extended to Minister of Defence General Magnus Malan, Finance Minister Barend du Plessis – although he wasn’t named in the book – and Environment Minister John Wiley. They supposedly commandeered a South African Air Force helicopter to fly them and their under-age victims to Bird Island.
It was Co-authored by Mark Minnie, former narcotics policeman in Port Elizabeth and investigative journalist Chris Steyn.
Script: In our last story we exposed an email from Minnie to the editors “We have no concrete evidence to the effect that the 3 ministers sexually molested a victim.” Weeks later Mark Minnie committed suicide
Link 11 07 08 13 Earlier this week NB Publishers issued a statement apologising unreservedly for any allegations that implicated Barend Du Plessis and that all unsold copies of the Lost Boys of Bird Island would be removed from the bookstores
Derek [[08:46:34 Barend this apology from NB publishers how you feel about it.
Barend [08 47 57 ] They did that apologizing, but still suggesting that I'm guilty. No, that apology is a dishonest, half hearted thing.
Script: The lines he objects to are “Statements are made which may suggest that Mr Barend Du Plessis, though not mentioned by name, might have been involved in the sexual abuse of underaged boys…..
And the “The contested statements could not be verified independently.”
Script: Barend’s attorney Johan Victor has spent the last year trying to reach an agreement with NB Publishers
Johan [09:42:23] Quite frankly, the public out there reading this apology say, OK, so it wasn't Barend. So who else could it have been? But over and above that, it doesn't say we actually apologized to the Malan and the Wiley families because we implicated those two ministers.
Link 10 08 47 17 Many questions were raised in our story a year ago but the Lost Boys of Bird Island remained on the shelves and Barend Du Plessis continued the quest to clear his name
Barend [08. 34 19] We've worked very, very hard I'm smiling because I think we have information and evidence to turn the tables
Script: Victor and Private Investigator Wouter De Swardt have spent the last year tracking down people central to the story, getting sworn affidavits. A critical character is former senior state prosecutor John Scott who Minnie says stopped the investigation into the paedophile ring in 1986, implying Scott played a major part in this Apartheid conspiracy.
John [10:37:49] I was devastated. Look, I seriously considered legal action myself. But, I know what it entails, and I wasn't going to set aside two or three years of my life to pursue a claim for damages
john [11:08:44] where he says back in my office, I reread the SPP entry in my docket. It's written in bold red ink and reads as follows. All investigation into this matter must cease immediately signed John Scott.
john [11:08:59] Now, I wouldn't have written anything on the docket in red ink. I do recall that police were rather finicky about our entries into the dockets as prosecutors. …and I certainly wouldn't have instructed that further investigations or all investigations, as he put it, were to cease immediately. If I had known about it. I would not have covered it up. I would certainly have done everything I could to expose it by way of a prosecutor. But there wasn't anything like it.
Script: In the book the paedophile ring was said to be orchestrated by one man – police reservist and businessman Dave Allen, but after he was arested for pornography he committed suicide. What is fact, is Dave Allen was due to appear in court before Senior State Prosecutor John Scott.
John [11:06:24... I was asked to hold back the matter because he wasn't there and they were looking for him, which I did. And later on in the morning, I was told that they found him at Schoenmakerskop he'd committed suicide or he was dead. I closed off the docket, and that was the end of the matter. You can't prosecute a guy from the grave.
Script: John Scott says no one has ever contacted him to verify the facts.
The second affidavit they got was from the CEO of the fertilizer company which had the licence to collect guano from Bird island, and was responsible for issuing permits to visit the island.
Script: I was personally present on Bird Island when any senior member of the Government visited the island……there were never any boys under the age of 21 on the island regardless of race…..there were no despicable sexual acts with minor boys
Link: 11 05 33 11 Another witness to come forward to testify about what happened on that fishing trip so pivotal to the book is marine biologist Willie Maritz. He was on the island the entire week the ministers visited and only left once they had departed
Willie 00.02.52.15 Most of the time you could see everybody on the island, obviously there are rocky outcrops where people go fishing, jetties and coves and things, it is a fairly flat island, the highest point I think is about, not even five metres above sea level.
Script: Willie would spend a week, every 6 weeks, working on Bird Island for 3 years, and happened to be on the island that week of the fishing trip
Willie 00.04.51.24, We would all share accommodation, we spent most of the time in each other’s company, the island headman had his own house, but the other people who went to the island shared accommodation.
Willie 00 08 58 Apart from the crew on the chopper, I cannot recall that there was anyone else there, I know that during that week, Mr Hans Beneke was also on that island, he was from Atlas Organic Fertilisers, and I believe that he was their host, of these ministers, and Mr Dave Allen was there, and there were no children, absolutely never
Script: This week we unpicked a central piece of the plot, the part where a coloured child is flown in the middle of the night from Bird Island in a military helicopter, with a gunshot wound in his anus, allegedly inflicted by Magnus Malan. Co-author Minnie claimed a critical tape recording with the matron who treated the child, was stolen by the police.
11. 10 30 02 To date the former state surgeon Dr Andrew Hillock has refused to speak out because of patient confidentiality but this week he agreed to make a sworn affidavit and it reads ,........... simple as that
Script: The slur of being a paedophile hangs heavily over Barend Du Plessis and the families
Barend [08:37:19 And there are millions of people who think that I am a paedophile. And there was no evidence when they published the book. And today there is still not a shred of evidence.. This slur is clinging to me like my shadow…. It bothers me. when I walk into a shop people look at me and then look away. It doesn't leave me. I've got two granddaughters in a very nice school in Johannesburg. I didn't see my way open to go to any of their prize giving ceremonies like in the past. Then they would say oupa is a paedophile or some criminal.
ORIGINAL STORY Script: The Wiley family have lived under a similar cloud for the last 30 years. They investigated Wiley’s suicide and the paedophile allegation thoroughly when the story first hit the press in Playboy Magazine, the article was later retracted. Wiley visited Bird Island three times, accompanied by fisheries officials on two occasions and on the fishing trip with Du Plessis and Malan.
Link 11 03 30 10 the ashes of John Wiley are scattered in this family graveyard at Noordehoek in the Cape, the allegations that he was a paedophile and possibly even eliminated by an Apartheid hit squad have made it difficult for the family to find peace
Mark [10:30:27] It had an incredible effect on our family. He said the day that he died, he was meant to come pick up his granddaughter. It's his first grandchild. And by 10.30 he hadn't arrived. And when the story broke with Playboy 10 years later, she was in school. And we had to remove her from the boarding house.
Derek [10:31:01] Because of the rumors?
Mark [10:31:04] Yeah, it's persisted with us for years. Even now, it's having an effect on our children.
Mark [10:37:42] But what the public just doesn't know is that printing books is completely different. They aren't covered by the Press Council. So the only way in which you can get it withdrawn is by going to court [10:37:56] all our legal advice was, if you do …..the books will fly off the shelves.
derek [08 55 20] have any so-called victims or witnesses
Barend [08 55 27] Not in the last 32 years.
derek [10:41:29] Have any so-called victims or witnesses come forward
Mark [10:41:39].Nobody ever led a charge. Nothing. It's all just a fabrication.
Derek [08:58:18] Now, there was talk of this high level police investigation, have the police approached you at all?
Barend [08:58:26] No, I've never had a call from any policeman. We laid complaint with it, with the police, Ombit to say, you know, tell us no. Have you got something against Barend Duplessis or not? No, replied.
Link 11 07 35 13 Despite it being taken off the shelves NB publishers say they will defend any attempt to discredit the contents of the book and this apology is limited to Mr Du Plessis and does not extend to any other person identified in the book
Mark [10:58:46] Well, that's absolutely bizarre. I mean, all the evidence that we've discovered has shown that the whole story is a complete fabrication. They admitted it themselves that they have no facts or evidence, yet they're not prepared to take ownership of the most egregious piece of yellow journalism, …. They know that the dead man can't sue.
Script: We asked the author Chris Steyn and the publishers for comment
LINK “ We sent all these affidavits and allegations to NB publishers in writing and requested an on camera interview they responded by referring us back to their press statement saying we have no further comment
Derek [09:47:09 The point is will that claim for damages land.
Johann [09:47:15] Yes, we are definitely still looking at all those options
Script: On the morning NB Publishers were due to release their apology, Barend Du Plessis legal team released all the affidavits to the press, and on a website they will publish the rest of the evidence including emails from Minnie written to the editor prior to publication. Now it’s up to the public to decide - was this book fact or fiction?

metadata.Summary: “The Lost Boys of Bird Island” is billed as a shocking expose of a violent paedophile ring involving national party ministers and young coloured boys in the eighties. It rocked the country as the latest dark secret to be revealed from the apartheid era. It alleged an appalling abuse of power – power that extended to Minister of Defence General Magnus Malan, Finance Minister Barend du Plessis – although he wasn’t named in the book – and Environment Minister John Wiley. They supposedly commandeered a South African Air Force helicopter to fly them and their under-age victims to Bird Island. Ever since the book was published Barend Du Plessis has been trying to clear his name and demanding that Media 24 take down all the Google posts, withdraw the books and publish an unequivocal apology admitting they had no concrete evidence and that book should never have been published as fact. John Scott the public prosecutor who is alleged to have called Minnie in and told him to stop his investigation into the Ministers because he got instructions from “on Top” denies he ever met Minnie or that he ever got such instructions. His only involvement was after David Allen was arrested for procession of pornographic material he committed suicide and so the case was closed. That was it, Minnie entire story that the only hard evidence was stolen from him and on which Chris Steyn etc have based the reason for not having hard evidence falls apart
metadata.Further information: Wileys sons have spent years investigating their fathers history and have never found a victim. Other key witnesses are Willie Maritz an ornithologist who spent the weekend in question on the island with them and was in their company most of the time and would have noticed any flights or children on the island. (we have done this interview) Then there is Beneke who had the guano concession for Bird Island and his affidavit says he controlled all accces to the island at the time. Media 24’s legal team said when Willem Breytenbach a senior media 24 employee when he was arrested for paedophilia all they needed was one credible affidavit and they could release the story. Yet Minnie said weeks before the publication of “The Lost Boys on Bird Island” that they did not have any such affidavit against the Ministers yet they went ahead and published saying the press are governed under media legislation that does not apply to publications of books, and dead men cannot sue the only possible person is Barend. Barend is elderly and dying of lung cancer and they know he will be dead before he can successfully clear his name.
